assertion: A preserve-3d parent isolates its planes from the page. Unlike the 2D control, a plane over a transparent scene backdrop retains its foreground colors. Half opacity composites the complete plane result once.

browser.reason: Reviewed PNGs and difference images. Chrome preserves the filtered backdrop and applies foreground blending before final source-over; Firefox/WebKit captures omit invert even in the standalone control in this environment. See ../backdrop-blend/README.md. Chrome and WebKit agree on the isolated planes; Firefox omits them in this capture. Only one output channel level differs across 33600 translucent pixels; geometry and opaque regions were reviewed.
